tada.config.title: TADA Settings
tada.config.section.loot: Loot: chance for one finished TADA piece
tada.config.onlyTadaArmor.tooltip: ON: only TADA armor gives trim abilities. OFF: any trimmed armor gives them (diamond, netherite, modded). Server-side: on a dedicated server, set it in the server's config/tada.json.
tada.config.goldTrimCountsForPiglins.too: ON: a worn piece with a gold trim material counts as golden armor, so piglins stay peaceful. Server-side setting.
tada.config.strengthLevelsPerPiece.toolt: How many Strength levels each Strength-trimmed piece adds. 2 means one piece = Strength II, four pieces = Strength VIII. Server-side setting.
tada.config.strengthMaxLevel.tooltip: Highest Strength level that can be reached, however many pieces are worn. Server-side setting.
tada.config.checkIntervalTicks.tooltip: How often the worn armor is checked, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). Lower values react faster but cost a little more. Raises the effect duration if needed. Server-side setting.
tada.config.effectDurationTicks.tooltip: How long each applied effect lasts, in ticks. It must stay at least 201 ticks above the check interval, otherwise the HUD icon blinks and Night Vision flickers (vanilla does that below 10 seconds). The effect also lingers this long after taking the armor off. Server-side setting.
tada.config.showAbilityHints.tooltip: ON: item tooltips show "Ability: ..." on smithing templates and on trimmed armor that really gives that ability. The hint is calculated from the trim, so it also works on pieces you already own. In multiplayer it follows the server's "Only TADA armor" rule. Client-side setting.
tada.config.lootChanceEndCity.tooltip: Chance that one finished TADA piece (enchanted, maybe trimmed and dyed) is added. Applies per chest, on top of the normal loot. 0% turns it off. Server-side setting; takes effect at once, also on already generated chests that were not opened yet.

tada.config.lootTrimChance.tooltip: Chance that a found TADA piece carries a trim. The pattern is random among those that have an ability. Server-side setting.
tada.config.lootDyeChance.tooltip: Chance that a found TADA piece is dyed in one or two random colors. Server-side setting.
tada.config.lootEnchantLevelsMin.tooltip: Lowest enchanting-table level used to enchant a found piece. Server-side setting.
tada.config.lootEnchantLevelsMax.tooltip: Highest enchanting-table level used to enchant a found piece. If lower than the minimum, the minimum is used. Server-side setting.
tada.config.traderSellsTemplates.tooltip: ON: the wandering trader can offer a random armor trim template that has an ability, for 24 emeralds and 2 diamonds. Whether he does is decided when he spawns, so it does not affect traders that already exist. Server-side setting.
tada.config.traderSellsArmor.tooltip: ON: the wandering trader can offer a finished TADA piece (enchanted, maybe trimmed and dyed) for 64 emeralds and 8 diamonds. Decided when he spawns. Server-side setting.
